title: Supplementary Information for the 2027-2029 Immigration Levels Plan
key_claim: Permanent resident admissions stay at 380,000 a year and new temporary arrivals at 370,000 for 2027-2029, with a separate time-limited 2027 measure to process permanent residence for in-Canada workers and long-waiting humanitarian cases, and a target of a temporary-resident share below 5%.
frame_summary: IRCC presents the plan as stabilised, sustainable levels, with the in-Canada transition measure framed as added processing space rather than as part of the headline targets.
verbatim_quote: Targets for new temporary resident arrivals will stabilize at 370,000 for all three years of the 2027-2029 Levels Plan.
verbatim_list: Overall permanent resident admissions will remain at 380,000 for all three years
IRCC is also introducing a new time-limited measure to provide additional space to process permanent residence applications in 2027 within two cohorts:
the workers cohort will transition in-Canada workers and their accompanying family members to permanent residence
to reach the less than 5% non-permanent resident target
notes: Primary notice. Quote and list items confirmed character for character on the live page by an independent web fetch on 15/11/2026 (FOUND-EXACT, ASCII hyphen in 2027-2029).

title: 2026 Annual Report to Parliament on Immigration
key_claim: Canada transitioned nearly 170,000 temporary workers and students to permanent residence in 2025.
frame_summary: The minister's message frames in-Canada transitions as a coordinated way to keep skilled people already in the country while immigration levels are reduced.
verbatim_quote: we transitioned nearly 170,000 temporary workers and students
notes: Quote confirmed FOUND-EXACT in the minister's message on the live page by independent web fetch, 15/11/2026.

title: Canada's population estimates, second quarter 2026
key_claim: Canada's population was 41,798,407 on 1 July 2026; the non-permanent resident count was 2,779,774, down 0.7% in the quarter.
frame_summary: Statistics Canada reports the quarterly estimate as data, showing slow total growth alongside a falling temporary-resident count.
notes: Figures confirmed FOUND-EXACT on the live release by independent web fetch, 15/11/2026; -0.7% is the period-to-period change shown under the NPR estimate.

title: Monetary Policy Report, October 2026: Projections
key_claim: The Bank revised Canada's population up, which raises its estimate of potential output.
frame_summary: The Bank treats the population revision as a supply-side input that lifts potential output in its projection.
verbatim_quote: Potential output is also higher due to an upward revision to Canada’s population.
notes: Quote confirmed on the live page by independent web fetch, 15/11/2026; the page uses a right single quote (U+2019) in Canada's.

title: New Immigration Levels Plan adds upside to population growth outlook
key_claim: RBC puts the 2027 permanent-resident ceiling at 662,000 once the 200,000 transitions and carried-over admissions are added; about 200,000 temporary residents convert each year anyway, so conversions would need to double without fewer departures to cut population; temporary outflow fell short by about half of target in 2025; the temporary share could fall below 6% in 2027 but likely not to 5%.
frame_summary: RBC argues the new plan adds upside to population growth because conversions do not remove people and departures have lagged target.
verbatim_quote: bringing the total PR ceiling to 662,000 next year
verbatim_list: Since roughly 200,000 NPRs transition to permanent residency annually anyway
the number of NPR conversions would need to double without reducing the number of departures from Canada
fell short by roughly half of target in 2025
The NPR share of the total population could drop below 6% next year
it likely won’t reach its 5% goal in 2027
notes: All spans confirmed on the live page by independent web fetch, 15/11/2026; won't uses a right single quote (U+2019).

title: Population in Canada: Adjustments
key_claim: The temporary-resident share stood at 6.7% in the latest estimate; in April to June 2026 NPR outflows were 138,913 against inflows of 120,038; Scotiabank judges the 5% goal by end-2027 still achievable.
frame_summary: Scotiabank reads the quarterly data as an adjustment in progress and argues the end-2027 temporary-share goal remains within reach.
verbatim_quote: the share of NPR to the total population now stands at 6.7%
verbatim_list: achieving the 5% goal by the end of 2027 remains intact
notes: Spans confirmed in the PDF text by independent web fetch, 15/11/2026; 138,913 is the NPR Outflows value and 120,038 the NPR Inflows value for Apr-Jun 2026 in the components table.

title: Canada's new immigration plan revealed in federal budget
key_claim: The plan offers permanent status to up to 200,000 longtime temporary residents outside the broad target; the temporary share peaked at 7.4% in October 2024; the Conservative critic said the government would cook the books by leaving transitions out of the broad target.
frame_summary: The Canadian Press reports the plan as flat headline levels paired with a large one-off shift of temporary residents to permanent status, and records the opposition charge that this flatters the target.
verbatim_quote: offering permanent status to up to 200,000 longtime temporary residents who have already applied
verbatim_list: peaked at 7.4 per cent of the total population in October 2024
notes: Canadian Press wire republished by BNN Bloomberg; meta article:published_time reads 2026-11-06T11:09:33Z and the canonical points to ctvnews.ca, the visible dateline gives 5 November. Spans confirmed FOUND-EXACT by independent web fetch, 15/11/2026.
